# Stock / VO hosts the sandbox may fetch via the forward proxy (GET/HEAD only).
# Matching is suffix-based: "pexels.com" also allows "www.pexels.com" and "videos.pexels.com".
#
# HTML pages on pexels.com / pixabay.com often return Cloudflare challenges (HTTP 403
# "Just a moment...") to non-browser clients. Prefer the official APIs:
#   api.pexels.com  (Authorization: $PEXELS_API_KEY)
#   pixabay.com/api/... (?key=$PIXABAY_API_KEY)
# then download the MP4/CDN link from the JSON response.
# Mixkit / coverr / archive.org / wikimedia remain good keyless fallbacks.

api.pexels.com
pexels.com
videos.pexels.com
images.pexels.com
# Pexels video_files links sometimes resolve via Vimeo CDN
vimeocdn.com
player.vimeo.com
pixabay.com
cdn.pixabay.com
i.vimeocdn.com
mixkit.co
assets.mixkit.co
coverr.co
cdn.coverr.co
videvo.net
cdn.videvo.net
freesound.org
cdn.freesound.org
incompetech.com
freepd.com
archive.org
download.archive.org
commons.wikimedia.org
upload.wikimedia.org
pond5.com
istockphoto.com
media.istockphoto.com
shutterstock.com
stock.adobe.com

# gTTS scratch VO (Green Energy); disable by removing these lines if VO must stay offline
translate.google.com
www.google.com
